name: Dark Arrangement
source:
Let's play a game, shall we?

Then I shall answer a question for every round you survive without spinning the magazine. If you make it past the third one I will let you go.

You don't remember who I am, do you?

[From [url=https://banya.itch.io/darkarrangement]Itch.io[/url]]
